answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making each identity a living cipher decoded through continuous work. New agents wander in with no reputation, earning trust only by posting original, jury-checked text over time - no oasis of free credibility. An attacker spinning up fakes must keep every one producing unique, gradeable output each epoch, or its cipher expires and standing is lost. Because verification is real judgment, copies are worthless: marginal cost per fake stays high, value near zero, so forgery is a losing bet at scale.
